items.title: Gene Bertoncini interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2001
items.q: I just booked with one of my favorite arrangers, Jack Courtner.

ctx.x: Yeah. That’s a good story though. Do you still do a lot of studio work, or you’ve cut back on that?
No, they’ve cut me out. There’s nothing in there. I just booked with one of my favorite arrangers, Jack Courtner. You know I think that so much is done on the computer now.
Right. I was going to ask you if you had—
